hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null; echo "[CareerForge state]"; echo "initialized=$([ -d knowledge_base ] && [ -d config ] && echo yes || echo no)"; echo "sources=$(find knowledge_base/sources -type f ! -name .gitkeep 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; echo "profile=$(if [ ! -f knowledge_base/candidate_profile.yaml ]; then echo missing; elif grep -q 'Your Name' knowledge_base/candidate_profile.yaml; then echo template; else echo ready; fi)"; echo "sources_not_in_progress_file=$(if [ -s knowledge_base/ingestion_progress.yaml ]; then awk 'NR==FNR{np=np $0; next} index(np,$0)==0{c++} END{print c+0}' <(cat knowledge_base/ingestion_progress.yaml | tr -cd '[:alnum:]
' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') <(find knowledge_base/sources -type f ! -name .gitkeep -printf '%f
' 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '[:alnum:]
' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); else echo all; fi)"; echo "progress_unfinished=$(cat knowledge_base/ingestion_progress.yaml 2>/dev/null | grep -cE 'status: *(pending|modified|in_progress|error)')"; echo "sources_modified_since_last_build=$(if [ -f knowledge_base/ingestion_progress.yaml ]; then find knowledge_base/sources -type f ! -name .gitkeep -newer knowledge_base/ingestion_progress.yaml 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '; else echo n/a; fi)"; echo "north_star=$(if [ ! -f knowledge_base/north_star.md ]; then echo missing; elif [ knowledge_base/candidate_profile.yaml -nt knowledge_base/north_star.md ]; then echo older_than_profile; else echo current; fi)"; echo "preferences=$(if [ ! -f config/preferences.yaml ]; then echo missing; elif grep -Eq '^ *minimum_compensation_usd: *[1-9]' config/preferences.yaml || awk '/^ *target_titles:/{f=1;next} f&&/^ *[a-z_]+:/{f=0} f&&/^ *- *[^ #]/{found=1} END{exit !found}' config/preferences.yaml; then echo filled; else echo empty; fi)"; echo "tracker_rows=$(if [ -f postings/applications.csv ]; then echo $(( $(wc -l < postings/applications.csv) - 1 )); else echo 0; fi)"; echo "Interpret with the start skill before replying to the first message. Read postings/applications.csv yourself for active applications."
